selectionRule: Max VORP descending; ties by SHA-256 of source player name with fixed gb-target-v1 prefix. Names are replaced by rank aliases before persistence.
middleFiveRule: Sort eligible predictions by predicted amount descending, then stable manager alias ascending; select five beginning at floor((n - 5) / 2).
managerAliasRule: Stable Manager NN labels assigned by SHA-256 digest order with a fixed private-to-report namespace; source names and digests are not retained.
